corpus: dev raw_articles.entities, 1782 articles, snapshot 2026-10-02 (project ref qzothzirwwpesafzlxtw). A surface is only a fact about the newswire if the wire printed it: dev_mentions counts the mentions of that exact spelling as that entity type in this corpus, so every rule asserted below has evidence behind it. 0 means the spelling was never printed and the pair exists to pin a rule down (or because the corpus only prints another spelling of the same referent, noted in why).

labels.same: the two surface forms name one real-world referent, so they must resolve to one canonical entity
labels.different: the two surface forms name two referents, so they must not resolve to one canonical entity
